run_descriptor_tests: run the protobuf descriptor unit tests via unittest.main to verify descriptor behavior
test_descriptor_make_descriptor: test the MakeDescriptor function by building a Descriptor from a DescriptorProto with nested fields
test_descriptor_copy_to_proto: test the CopyToProto method to serialize a Descriptor back into a DescriptorProto
test_descriptor_get_options: test the GetOptions method to retrieve custom options attached to a descriptor
test_descriptor_enum_value_name: test the EnumValueName method to look up an enum value name by its numeric value
